name: vuesp.relay-x2-modbus1-1
summary: ESP32 relay board with two relays, two opto-isolated inputs and RS485 Modbus RTU slave.
description:
## Vuesp Relay X2 Modbus V1.1

Firmware for the LC Technology **ESP32_Relay_X2_Modbus_V1.1** board. The project exposes two relays (GPIO33, GPIO25), two opto-isolated inputs (GPIO27, GPIO26) and six free pads (G5, RX2, TX2, G21, G22, G23) in the local Vuesp web interface.

The RS485 interface (TX GPIO19, RX GPIO18, DE GPIO32) runs as a Modbus RTU **slave** with a fixed register map, 9600 8N1 by default and 4800/9600/19200 support. Settings and status are available on the `/device/modbus/` page and are stored in ConfigStore.

Master mode is planned as a separate, mutually exclusive mode because the board has a single UART and DE line.
